svg.text: Time structure: is either scan's difference tied to elapsed time or to the first count window?
(a) tail residuals (6.2-15.2 mV) against elapsed time in the scan, Pearson (obs - fit)/sqrt(fit)
elapsed time t_s in the scan (s)
Fit: noise ln-quadratic + exponential dark, per scan (03). 13:20 alternates high/low from 6.4 mV: lag-1 correlation -0.28 over 6.2-10 mV.
Same elapsed time, different rates: at 6.0-7.2 mV both scans were at t = 241-335 s, and 16:36 reads x0.67.
(b) first 10-ms window counting kappa x the later windows: profile likelihood from the live-time fingerprint
(b): values above 12 drawn at 12; 9 kappa values, 3 rates, 3000 runs of the driver's _measure_point per point. The CSVs do not log single count periods; the total live time is a partial fingerprint.
